**[MUSIC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1A-936wKY0)**
You approach a rocky outcropping, vibrant red and purple flowers bloom around you as you walk towards this simple yet beautiful structure, an almost natural looking cave, inside a gigantic room, with pillars and a domed stone roof like a more complete Stonehenge. 
Out of the corner of your eye you spot something faintly shiny, behind a pile of rocks, a broken sword. It is larger than a typical greatsword, faint orange runes across the flat side of the blade. Melantha's greatsword. 
You enter the tunnel and begin to see small blue strings, red strings, of all colors and types tied from one to another, they occupy the entire space of the room and consume it in their massive scale. As you enter the room is just barely lit dimly, and you see no sign of a person here. A faint skitter sound echoes through the room, and a disembodied trio of voices calls out, "You have come. Come far... come quickly, but you did not bring it."

**THE WEAVER**: 
- We are fate, future, for all that is and will be. This world must live for our threads to be woven. We will help you adventurers. You must seek the [[Qithar's Ritual of Binding]]. Seal the devil in stone, and save our world.
- To seal him you will need power... power from the Primes, and the Gods. 
- **POWER OF GODS:** White Wizard, you must seek the Mother of Magic, bring to her that which The One who Casts has hidden since the beginning. Bring his secret to Telura, and she will grant you her boon. Reister, you must prove once again to your Lord that you are worthy of wielding the volatile power of time. He will guide you to Oztar, the relic of the Blue Solstice. Earn this great boon, and be reborn, a demi-god.
- **POWER OF PRIMES:** I see strings, cut snipped, torn to shreds. There are no worlds... no fates... no timeliness. where you win with gods alone. You must find the powers of our world. The nature of magic, the elements, harness the power of those known as, [[The 12 Prime Creations]]. The Crystal Dragon, The Golden Naiad, The Tree Father, and The Last Comet. The children of the Elder God, you must pass their trials and tests. Their gifts will even your odds, and strengthen your threads. You shall cut, we will weave, and we will weaken Arkonil's hold on your fates for as long as we can.
- We can see no further, and meddle no more in your mortal affairs. You have our aid, any more will upset the balance Daraan has built, and your world will fall to further pieces than it already has. You must leave now, we see, it is time, something else is waiting...

**OVERVIEW FOR DM/PLAYERS:** Ok so, there's a lot here, let's unpack. The Fates said a lot but here's the bullet points:
- *DM ONLY:* [[Supernatural Allies & Gifts]]
- Seek out *Qithar's Ritual of Binding*
- Ivys must find *The One Who Casts*, and bring his secret to Telura to earn her favor
- They will need more power than that to get him in a state to be sealed so they need to find these Prime Creations and get their help:
	- The Crystal Dragon
	- The Golden Naiad
	- The Tree Father
	- The Last Comet

They depart the Tears, convening outside underneath an outcropping, protecting them from the sudden downpour. Let them talk for a while as the storm gathers, it'll be a rough trek back to the main road from here. The nearest village is hours away but it should have somewhere they can stay.

As they talk, Emrys, you begin to feel an uneasiness in the pit of your stomach. You reach into your pack to grab a bit of bread, perhaps you're just hungry after a difficult day, but the feeling won't leave. It's as if your body is trying to tell you something... you shouldn't be here? Maybe you need to get back on the road? Are you in danger? No, you realize as your divine sense screeches through your mind. You aren't in danger, you're going to die.

The storm grows louder around you, you call out to your friends but under the sound of thunder they don't hear you. Thunder claps and in the light of the lightning you see a cloaked figure, wearing a broken bronze crown with a skull faceplate, and a wicked red blade on his back, approaching in the darkness. He disappears in the shadows as the world goes dark, becoming visible in the next strike of lightning barely 30ft away from you. A booming voice, drowning out the thunder shouts, low and loud yet still soft, like the whisper of a giant...

**Ivar**- "I want to know why my wife is dead."

And that's where we are gonna end tonight's session!
